rita: quick sync - i'm iterating on the Branch Guardian prototype (canary + auto-fallback). core idea: split responsibilities into Gate (traffic split), Probe (signal ingestion), Operator (actuate change). lightweight and composable.

anil: sounds good. question: who makes the final call during anomalies? local node vs control plane?

tom: prefer hybrid. local nodes can act for a short autonomous_window to meet latency SLOs, but control plane publishes signed manifests and can override with a lease.

nina: agreed. manifest pinning: routers accept only signed manifest versions; if signature invalid they roll back to last_safe_manifest. overrides must include an expires_at so they don't persist across partitions.

rita: operator contract sketch: POST /agent/v1/op/apply -> returns op_id + revert_token + ttl_s. revert requires the token. ensure idempotency and auditability.

anil: reconciliation is tricky. propose a compact op ledger: nodes append op summaries to central aggregator when connectivity restored (op_id, manifest_version, ts, node_id). use deterministic conflict rules (last-ts, tie-breaker node-id) and surface ambiguous merges to ops.

tom: expose a tiny policy eval API: evaluate(manifest_version, local_signals) -> {action, confidence, hint} and keep the evaluator stateless for fast restarts.

nina: metrics/alerts: operator_apply_latency_seconds, operator_conflicts_total, gate_active_slice_percent. page if conflicts > 0 for N minutes to avoid silent oscillation.

rita: long-term: migrate Gate DSL into a typed policy language so we can run static safety checks and unit tests in CI. also add dry-run mode for operators.

anil: test plan: chaos harness that partitions control plane for varying durations and clock skew; assert nodes respect autonomy_window and then reconcile deterministically.

infra-bot: deploybot: staged canary for ranker-v4 started 2026-03-25T07:12Z slice=4%

rita: next: i'll open an RFC with sequence diagrams for apply/revert, revert_token lifecycle, signed-manifest flow, and a minimal HTTP contract. please add review comments on safety heuristics.
